content.text:
I'm looking at the grid with background 4 and object color 0, noticing a rectangle spanning rows2-7 cols2-12 plus a stray cell at (1,1). This looks like a single defect I need to reconcile—possibly extending the rectangle to include row1, or treating that stray cell as the anomaly to fix.

I'll go with completing the shape into a full rectangle covering rows1-7 and cols1-12, filling in the missing edge cells with 0s.
